business_problem: While they were still in college, Michael Royzen and Justin Wei saw the potential for using large language models (LLMs) together with high-quality context to build an intelligent search engine for developers.
solution_summary: While they were still in college, Michael Royzen and Justin Wei saw the potential for using large language models (LLMs) together with high-quality context to build an intelligent search engine for developers. When a developer uses Phind, they can type in a complex coding question to the search bar and receive an answer generated by AI along with links on the side to online sources. Phind can answer coding and development-related questions with much more precision than a generic search engine because it is trained in this context. The company trained its LLMs using NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU-powered Amazon EC2 P4d Instances —which deliver high performance for machine learning training and high performance computing applications in the cloud—and NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU-powered Amazon EC2 P5 Instances , the highest performance GPU-based instances for deep learning and high performance computing applications.

business_outcome: Phind is continuing to make its models faster and will continue using NVIDIA-powered Amazon EC2 P4d and Amazon EC2 P5 instances to achieve its goal. Using NVIDIA’s new TensorRT library, Phind expects to make its models five times faster than previously. While the company is still determining the best split of LLM training and inference across Amazon EC2 instances, it is very pleased with the overall performance.

evidence_quotes: When the cofounders of Phind were seniors at the University of Texas at Austin, they saw an opportunity to use LLMs as a search engine by feeding them high-quality context.
LLMs were becoming more accurate, but many still acted as summarizers.

While they were still in college, Michael Royzen and Justin Wei saw the potential for using large language models (LLMs) together with high-quality context to build an intelligent search engine for developers.

Software engineering requires a lot of specific knowledge, and traditional search engines often produce responses to technical questions that are too broad or shallow to help developers solve problems quickly.
When a developer uses Phind, they can type in a complex coding question to the search bar and receive an answer generated by AI along with links on the side to online sources.
Phind can answer coding and development-related questions with much more precision than a generic search engine because it is trained in this context.
